_style: Seamless tileable texture, flat orthographic front view filling the whole square, evenly lit with no shadows, no vignette, no perspective. Gritty mid-1990s PC first-person-shooter game texture, photographic but slightly painterly, strong contrast.

brick.prompt: Dark red-brown old brick wall, weathered bricks in running bond, dirty dark mortar, grime streaks.

asphalt.prompt: Cracked dark grey asphalt tarmac seen from directly above, oil stains, small stones, a few patched cracks.

render.prompt: Grimy grey painted concrete block exterior wall of a commercial building, rain streaks and dirt.

shutter.prompt: Galvanised corrugated steel roller shutter slats running horizontally, some rust spots and a few faded graffiti tags.

cinder.prompt: Institutional corridor wall of painted cinder blocks, pale grey-green gloss paint, scuffs and marks.

lino.prompt: Scuffed grey-green vinyl floor tiles seen from directly above, a 4 by 4 grid of square tiles, worn and dirty.

ceiling.prompt: Suspended office ceiling seen from directly below: a 2 by 2 grid of white speckled acoustic ceiling tiles in a thin metal grid, slightly yellowed, one with a water stain.

carpet.prompt: 1990s video arcade carpet seen from directly above: black background with a busy neon cosmic pattern of pink, cyan, yellow and purple squiggles, stars, planets and triangles.

door.prompt: Flat orthographic front view of a closed steel fire exit door filling the whole image, grey-green painted steel, stencilled text FIRE EXIT KEEP CLEAR, scuffs, a dented lower kick plate. Mid-1990s PC first-person-shooter game texture, photographic but slightly painterly.

cabinets.prompt: Three upright 1980s arcade cabinets side by side, flat orthographic front views, on a plain light grey background, evenly lit. Each has different original made-up marquee art (a space shooter, a car racing game, a kung fu fighting game), a switched-off dark screen, a control panel with a joystick and buttons, and a coin door. Mid-1990s PC first-person-shooter game sprite style, photographic but slightly painterly.

mineshift.prompt: Flat orthographic front view of one upright 1980s arcade cabinet filling the image, on a plain grey background. The illuminated marquee at the top reads MINE SHIFT in chunky blocky green letters. The glowing screen shows blocky pixel-art: an underground mine of stone and ore blocks with a pickaxe, and the words PRESS START. The control panel has one big red button. The coin door has a FREE PLAY sticker. The cabinet sides are painted with blocky dirt and grass block art. Mid-1990s PC game sprite style.

pinclaw.prompt: Two amusement machines side by side, flat orthographic front views, on a plain light grey background, both switched off: on the left a 1990s pinball machine showing its backglass with original made-up haunted graveyard art titled GRAVE DIGGER; on the right a claw crane machine with a glass case full of plush toys. Mid-1990s PC first-person-shooter game sprite style, photographic but slightly painterly.

truck.prompt: Flat orthographic side view of a white box truck on a plain light grey background. The livery on the box side reads GRAVEYARD SHIFT AMUSEMENTS in purple and green arcade lettering, with a cartoon ghost holding an arcade joystick. Slightly dirty. Mid-1990s PC first-person-shooter game texture, photographic but slightly painterly.

dumpster.prompt: Flat orthographic front view of a large green steel commercial dumpster bin with a closed lid, dented and dirty, a few stickers, on a plain light grey background. Mid-1990s PC first-person-shooter game texture, photographic but slightly painterly.

signs.prompt: A sheet of five separate flat signs on a plain light grey background, front views, evenly spaced, not overlapping: a green illuminated EXIT sign with a running man pictogram; a red and white STAFF ONLY door sign; a small round sticker reading FREE PLAY; a handwritten paper sign reading OUT OF ORDER; a small yellow and black NO ENTRY sign. Mid-1990s PC game texture style.

sprites.prompt: Game prop sprites on a plain flat light grey background, front views, evenly spaced and not overlapping: a rusty dented steel oil drum barrel; a white porcelain toilet seen from the front; a black office swivel chair; a pile of black rubbish bags; a single red brick. Mid-1990s PC first-person-shooter game sprite style, photographic but slightly painterly, evenly lit.
